summary: Both supplied tokens are already quoted in the correct boxes under II.1. The result is a verified no-change patch.

The Preterit has separate agent and recipient suffixes (-lux-li), with the report topic implicit. The Imperativ has a bare nominal notifyee ḥoli and the message in following quoted speech. This is ordinary reporting valency, not a new construction sense.
No new form, Detransitive function, idiom or contact analysis is warranted beyond the inherited Arabic etymology.
